title: Completion of the Selector Scan
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine and $y$ a Boolean input word whose length is at least the number of selector bits for $M$. After that many steps of $M$'s tabulating machine from its initial configuration on $y$, the machine is in state $\mathrm{fA}$ with false flag and selector bits given by the first $\mathrm{nbits}(M)$ bits of $y$. Its input head is at position $\min(\mathrm{nbits}(M)+1,|y|+1)$; all three auxiliary tapes are blank with their heads at zero, all simulated work tapes are blank with heads at zero, and the output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean Turing machine M
